posts.name: Rexxar Santaro
posts.cooked:
Queotzcatl:

It’s time to deliver the truth oh boys it’s about time.

Boy, oh boy! Whenever I see 3–5 billion ISK Marauder fits roaming around high-sec — or showing up on zKillboard — I can’t help but wonder what those pilots are thinking. Personally, I see no reason to push a Marauder fit much beyond 2 billion ISK, even if you’re chasing maximum DPS through expensive high-slot and low-slot upgrades.

I know the guy from that videoblog. He’s done a lot of good work for the EVE community. I occasionally use some of his fits myself, especially during events or when a new ship is introduced and I don’t have the time to develop my own setup from scratch. Many of his fits work well, but they often have a hidden weak spot somewhere. Sometimes I jokingly wonder whether he’s sponsored by Safety or Novus Ordo. His Golem analysis and fitting philosophy in that video are solid. He approaches ship fitting like an experienced painter creating a picture. That said, I still think the final Golem fit has some issues. It carries too much tank for high-sec PvE while simultaneously having too little tank to be truly comfortable against gankers. Ironically, many people tell me that my own fits are overly tanky for no reason.

BTW, the ability to use T2 ammunition in faction launchers and weapons has been around since the first Triglavian expansion.

Queotzcatl:

NAME one reason why it was ok to give gankers back the hedge, just ONE reason.

I’m listening.

Why are you talking about gankers?

This is a topic about Marauders and their PvP balance.

The extremely narrow niche of PvP of ‘gankers versus Marauders’ which only applies to a subset of space and a subset of players is a mere afterthought and not really relevant for how Marauders perform in all other PvP.

I understand that from the perspective of a player engaging in all possible PvP-evading strategies like a war-immune corp in high security space with permanent safeties green it may seem like ganking PvP is all the relevant PvP in the game, but the fact is that PvP in this game is much broader than that. And Marauders were oppressively strong in the broader game.

For HS Marauding you could do a T2 fit and/or stay away from busy places.

There’s no need to make game-breaking changes buffing Marauders to be a big issue again everywhere else in the game just because you don’t know how to deal with gankers.

Do you really need anything more than a T2 Marauder to deal with any PvE content in HS? Even a T2 Marauder sounds like overkill already.
